content.text: No non-compete, exclusivity, or field-of-use restriction binds the Customer anywhere in the agreement — in fact the Services clause affirmatively disclaims exclusivity.

input.quote: Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient. This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties.
input.rationale: Searches for exclusivity, competition, restriction, solicitation and "Customer shall/will not" language surface no non-compete, field-of-use or territory covenant binding AP. Clause 1 (p0001) expressly disclaims any exclusive arrangement and confirms AP remains free to offer or sell Inventory through other agents or third parties. The only Customer prohibitions (p0025) are ordinary license-scope and IP protections (no transfer, third-party access, reverse engineering, resale or service-bureau use of Kubient's Service) rather than restraints on AP's businesses, purchases or internal development. This satisfies the preferred position: no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer, so no redline is required.
